title: Quentin and the Language
author: Mirabel Whitlock
blurb: Rafael Dunmore, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
